name: snacktape
description: A video mixtape for replaying only your favorite YouTube moments.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && npx --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs && npm run smoke:dist
scripts.release:zip: npm run release:verify && npm run build && node scripts/create-release-zip.mjs
scripts.test:compiled: npm run clean && npx --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .tmp-tests/tests/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
